preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 2000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and 105, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices with indices between 1 and n, inclusive.
No edge connects a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the minimal number of merging operations required to make the given graph a caterpillar.
